headlines.text: How Virunga Park protects people and gorillas from Ebola in eastern DRC. Health checkpoints and surveillance aim to contain the outbreak and protect endangered mountain gorillas.
Trump cancels Iran strike, says ‘deal perimeters’ reached. The US president announced that he has cancelled a planned military strike on Iran, claiming progress in talks.
Israel kills eight in Gaza despite Trump’s Hamas disarmament plan. Strikes hit Gaza homes after the US unveiled plans for Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal.
Is criticism of Spain on border management legitimate or politics?. Tens of thousands of migrants briefly cross into Spain's north African territory of Ceuta from Morocco.
US embassies issue alerts after Trump vows to hit Iran ‘hard’. US embassies in the Middle East are bracing for possible escalation after Trump said the US will hit Iran 'hard'.
Thirteen dead in Peruvian tourist plane crash over Nazca Lines. Footage shows firefighters dousing the wreckage of a crashed tourist aircraft in southern Peru.
Gunman kills two in Idaho fast-food restaurant shooting. Deaths reported after gunman opens fire at In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho.
Hungary plans to shut down only nuclear power plant amid drought. Officials say they must shut down nation's sole nuclear plant as record-low Danube water levels disrupt reactor cooling.
Iran war live: Trump cancels attack, says ‘perimeters of a deal’ agreed. Move comes after Iran's top diplomat warned of a 'decisive response' to any US-Israeli 'aggression'.
Singapore bans UK band Massive Attack over Palestinian flag. Singapore barred two members of British band Massive Attack from re-entering the country.
New York Times reveals Trump administration subpoena over North Korea story. The Justice Department faces criticism for increasing use of subpoenas in attempts to compel journalists to reveal info.
Growing like ‘gangbusters’: Can Taiwan maintain its economic momentum?. Taiwan's GDP is soaring on back of US imports of AI chips, but experts warn that problems could arise with Trump, China.
Michigan joins Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks, with FBI investigating. No culprit has been identified in any of the attacks, which comes after authorities warned of possible Iranian plot.
US Arabs eye ‘historic’ Senate win for Abdul El-Sayed despite AIPAC attacks. Senate race in Michigan comes to embody Democratic rift over Israel, as AIPAC spends heavily against progressive doctor.
Why did Ceuta migrant mayhem chill already frosty Israel-Spain relations?. What caused more than 50,000 migrants to storm a Spanish enclave in Africa, and did Israel have anything to do with it?
Fox News Campus Radicals Newsletter: Parents left in the dark, Trump starving socialist breeding grounds. Stay up to date with the Fox News Campus Radicals newsletter.

Texas man allegedly bought 77 head of cattle with bad checks totaling over $159K: sheriff. A 25-year-old man from Barry, Texas, allegedly used bad checks to purchase 77 head of cattle worth over $159,000 from Buffalo Livestock Marketing.

Chiefs rookie standout Cyrus Allen exits practice after scary collision with teammate Kaiir Elam. Tests revealed a shin bruise for Cyrus Allen after the Chiefs rookie collided with Kaiir Elam during a special teams drill at training camp.

Oba Femi shows the future of WWE is here as he takes down Brock Lesnar in Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam. Brock Lesnar delivered a tombstone piledriver and multiple F5s inside Hell in a Cell, but Oba Femi's Fall from Grace sealed a stunning outcome.

The Bellas' alliance with Paige crumbles after stunning SummerSlam loss to Fatal Influence. Nikki Bella turned on Paige with a vicious clothesline after Fatal Influence's SummerSlam victory, leaving her former partner stunned in the ring.

Randy Orton puts his fangs into Cody Rhodes, costs him WWE title against CM Punk at SummerSlam. Randy Orton's shocking RKO out of nowhere cost Cody Rhodes the Undisputed WWE Championship as CM Punk capitalized with a Go to Sleep at SummerSlam.

'Sopranos' star sings national anthem at Mets game on same day that fellow castmember dies. Jamie-Lynn Sigler sang the National Anthem at a New York Mets game on the same day Vincent Pastore's death was announced, stunning fans of the show.

Famed mountaineer Nirmal Purja, 43, among 10 climbers killed after avalanche in Pakistan. Nirmal Purja was leading climbers up Broad Peak in Pakistan when a deadly avalanche struck the Karakoram expedition, killing all 10 members of the group.

Liv Morgan proves herself as top women's star in WWE as she retains title at SummerSlam over Iyo Sky. Liv Morgan retained the Women's World Championship at SummerSlam after a brutal sequence of Oblivion finishers put Iyo Sky down for the count.

Stephanie White, let me 'educate' you on the science of why men don't belong in women's sports. Stephanie White said she wasn't educated enough on the science of males in women's sports. Here's what biology and sports science say about fairness.

Democratic socialist headed for $142K legislature salary begs for rent handout, deletes post after backlash. Brian Romero's GoFundMe seeking $2,000 for rent and groceries raised eyebrows given his expected $142,000 annual Assembly salary once sworn in.

Social media was not loving Caitlin Clark getting snubbed by TV network's MVP graphic. Ion's WNBA MVP race graphic left out Caitlin Clark, and social media fans had very strong reactions to the conspicuous omission of the No. 22 star.

Multiple people killed in shooting at Idaho In-N-Out restaurant, suspect dead. A gunman opened fire at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, leaving multiple fatalities before the suspected shooter was found deceased nearby.

Alexander Rossi reacts to his first laps in the next generation of IndyCar. Alexander Rossi called IndyCar's IR-28 shakedown at Indianapolis Motor Speedway smooth as "Christmas morning," but weather limited full testing.

Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi undergoes major surgery six months after her cervical cancer diagnosis. Snooki's emotional video documents her hysterectomy after cervical cancer, revealing which organs doctors removed to ensure they got everything.
